title: Kulaputta
text: 2. Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajiṃsu || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || 3. Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjissanti || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || 4. Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjanti || sabbe te catunnam ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || Katamesaṃ catunnam || || 5. Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || Dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa || || 6. Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ kulaputtā sammāagārasmā anagāriyam pabbajiṃsu || pabbajissanti || pabbajanti || sabbe te imesaṃ yeva catunnam ariyasaccānam yathābhūtam abhisamayāya || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhanti || pe || yogo karaṇīyo || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
